developmental_stage.evidence: Briefly, cortices obtained from 5–7 E14 embryos of both sexes per litter from at least 3 pregnant females were dissected in HBSS supplemented with 10 mM HEPES and dissociated by means of enzymatic digestion by incubating the tissue in DMEM containing 20 U/ml papain and 1 μg/ml cystein for 20 min at 37 °C, followed by mechanical trituration in DMEM supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum, obtaining neurons in suspension.
